decision: Lead with impact tiles: missed cutoffs, extra cost, staff time
why: A shift lead decides on outcomes and trade-offs, not on the agent's reasoning.
alternative: Open with the model's explanation text.
value: The decision takes seconds; the evidence is one click away.

decision: Each move is a separate replay-safe command applied together
why: Partial failure must be visible per order, and retries must not duplicate a reassignment.
alternative: One bulk update request for the whole plan.
value: Apply plan is atomic from the user's view and safe to retry.

decision: 'Why this plan' shows numbered reasons with scored sources
why: Trust comes from checkable evidence: SLA revision, ATP snapshot, picker pace.
value: Leads learn when to trust the agent and when to override it.

decision: Every source chip carries its timestamp or revision
why: A plan built on a 40-minute-old stock snapshot is a different plan.
alternative: Hide source freshness behind a tooltip.
value: Staleness is obvious before anyone applies the plan.
